main_body: A tiling strip of repeated wooden fence/post segments (farm fence): light-tan cap blocks over orange-brown faces, with a dark vertical rail/gap column and thin grey metal bars; each segment is about 15 rows tall.
top_band: Column x=7: rows 0-1 light tan #dcaf6c (2 rows), then rows 2-3 mid brown, then rows 4-14 dark brown. The 2-row tan band is only a cap line on the posts, not a real top surface.
evidence: The posts are drawn straight from the front. A 1-2 row light tan cap sits above a flat brown face, which is only a rim and not a foreshortened top. The rails and horizontal beams show no top faces, only thin grey 1-2 row bars. There is no distinct front edge line and no eave shadow, and nothing is inset. It reads as a front elevation with a hat and does not meet the frame contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 6 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 40 and 38 colours and 17-20 per tile for the references. Shading is shallow, with about 3 steps on the wood (tan, mid brown, dark brown). Surfaces are smooth bands with no grain, no per-plank highlights and no speckle. The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which is fine. Overall it is much thinner and flatter than the Beodeul props.
